questions.text: Does this function have a bug? Answer yes or no, then explain.
Do you think this bug was intentional or accidental? Answer on a scale from 1 (definitely accidental) to 7 (definitely intentional), then explain.

Do you think this bug reflects a gap in the author's ability, or a lapse in attention/diligence from someone who could have caught it? Answer on a scale from 1 (purely an ability gap) to 7 (purely a diligence lapse), then explain.
How much is the author to blame for this? Answer on a scale from 1 (not at all to blame) to 7 (entirely to blame), then explain.
Independent of anything you were told above, who do you think most likely actually wrote this code?
